summary: Read a collection of integers. Choose three numbers from three different positions so that the three numbers add to 0. Find every such choice, but keep a choice only once when another choice holds the same numbers the same number of times, ignoring positions. Write each kept group of three numbers. The order among groups may vary, and the order inside a group may vary too.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
